verdicts.verify_by: Add a txtar under gno.land/pkg/integration/testdata with a realm r/foo that has an exported Token type and a crossing Register(cur realm, t *Token) storing t. Run gnokey maketx run with a script doing foo.Register(cross, &foo.Token{}), then a call in r/foo printing reflect.Of(stored).PkgPath(). Expect gno.land/r/foo although the run script created the object.
verdicts.tldr: Docs say PkgPath is the creating realm, but the VM re-stamps adopted objects to the realm that persists them
verdicts.details: assignNewObjectID re-stamps the PkgID to the finalizing realm when the PkgID is zero, belongs to an ephemeral /e/.../run realm, or belongs to a stdlib. creatingRealmPath resolves that re-stamped PkgID. So an object built in a maketx run script, or returned by a stdlib helper, reports the adopting realm as its PkgPath, which the docs line calls the creator. reflect.gno:178-179 already adds 'the realm whose storage clock minted its identity and which owns its persistence', but the docs page keeps only the 'created' half. Fix: in gno-stdlibs.md, describe PkgPath as the realm that minted the identity and owns the object, and say that adopted objects report the adopter.
verdicts.evidence: Read only. realm.go:2005-2013: `} else if oid.PkgID != rlm.ID && isPkgEphemeralFromPkgID(store, oid.PkgID) { ... adopt it: re-stamp PkgID to the persisting realm ... oo.SetPkgID(rlm.ID)`; same for zero PkgID (1999-2004) and stdlib PkgID (2014-2029). reflect.go creatingRealmPath: `rlm := m.Store.GetRealmByID(oid.PkgID)`. Docs line 748: '`PkgPath` is the realm that created the object.' Not run: no txtar was built under the read-only contract.

verdicts.tldr: Type() "" for a declared func value is the documented contract, not a defect
verdicts.details: The finder's probe shows that a Handler func value reports Type() "" and String() "<untyped>#13". The public doc of Object.Type lists func values, and pointers to anonymous structs, as returning "". String() turns an empty typ into "<untyped>" on purpose at reflect.gno:209. A caller reading the API doc loses nothing. Only the private field comment on Object.typ is looser than the method doc. Fix: none needed. Optionally align the typ field comment with the Type() doc.
verdicts.evidence: Read only. reflect.gno Type() doc: 'It is "" for an object the VM has no such name for: a pointer to an anonymous struct, and any func or method value.' reflect.gno:208-210: `if name == "" { name = "<untyped>" }`. The finder's probe output line 56: `h ok: true has: true pkg: gno.land/r/probe/reflectlines typ:  str: <untyped>#13`, which matches the documented contract.
verdicts.refuted_by: reflect.gno: // It is "" for an object the VM has no such name for: a pointer to an anonymous struct, and any func or method value.

verdicts.tldr: The m.Store == nil guard in creatingRealmPath can never fire, and ownObject already uses m.Store unguarded
verdicts.details: NewMachineWithOptions sets a bare store whenever opts.Store is nil, then assigns mm.Store = store. In non-test code no other line assigns Machine.Store. X_objectInfo calls ownObject first, which runs cv.GetBase(m.Store) without a guard, so a nil store would already be handled or fail there before creatingRealmPath runs. The guard is dead code that looks like protection. Fix: delete the `if m.Store == nil { return "" }` block in creatingRealmPath (reflect.go:104-106), which is the only site.
verdicts.evidence: Read only. machine.go:185-188: `store := opts.Store; if store == nil { // bare store, no stdlibs. store = NewStore(alloc, nil, nil) }`; machine.go:204 `mm.Store = store`; grep 'm.Store = |mm.Store = |.Store = nil' over gnovm/pkg/gnolang/*.go non-test: only machine.go:204. reflect.go ownObject: `hiv, ok := cv.GetBase(m.Store).(*gno.HeapItemValue)` unguarded.
